note: What a release check can look for after the slice-1 release (HAD-795). Static files are served from /wp-content/plugins/nadlan-config/assets/rentals/; md5 of each served file must equal MANIFEST.json staged_md5.

static_files.scope_note: must_not_contain applies to the t2_* values only (the base file may use the word elsewhere)

admin_page_after_release.as: a logged-in administrator (nadlan_rentals_v2 = 'admin' shows v2 to administrators)
admin_page_after_release.script_order: rm-views.js, rm-drawers.js, rm-lease.js, rm-import.js, rm-portal.js, rm-plan2d.js, rm-today.js, rm-boot.js (boot last)

pilot_landlord_page_after_release.note: pilot landlords get the scripts but keep the present today view until option nadlan_rentals_today2_pilot = '1'

public_visitor_page.note: unchanged for a visitor: v2 is for administrators and pilots only (nadlan_rentals_v2 = 'admin'); no today2 key is needed

health: GET /wp-json/nadlan/v1/health must still answer with the version the release sets
not_measured: not measured on a real phone
